name: Indian Railway Finance Corporation Ltd.
about: Indian Railway Finance Corporation Limited engages in leasing of rolling stock and railway infrastructure assets in India. The company also engages in lending business to other entities under the Ministry of Railways; and borrowing funds from commercial markets, financial markets to finance the acquisition/creation of assets that are leased out to the Indian Railways. Indian Railway Finance Corporation Limited was incorporated in 1986 and is based in New Delhi, India.

coffee_can.note: Coffee Can for lenders uses ROE in place of ROCE (approximation).

buffett.name: Each ₹1 retained created ≥ ₹1 of market value

verdict.label: Looks expensive
reasons: Price implies ~14% a year profit growth for 10 years, versus ~5% that history and analysts support (reverse DCF at 10.8% cost of equity).
PE of 15 is near the bottom of its range over the last 3 years (median 25), though that is a short history to judge by.
Since 2023, most of the 31% a year price gain came from re-rating (PE 7 → 15), not earnings growth (5% a year).
